description: Resumes a paused Stripe subscription with billing cycle and proration options. Use when a customer wants to restart payment collection on a previously paused subscription.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for resuming a paused Stripe subscription.

billing_cycle_anchor.description: Determines timing for resumption. Options: 'now' (reset anchor to current UTC time) or 'unchanged' (advance to surrounding period). Default: 'now'.
billing_cycle_anchor.title: Billing Cycle Anchor

proration_behavior.description: Controls proration handling when anchor is 'unchanged'. Options: 'always_invoice' (immediate invoicing), 'create_prorations' (conditional invoicing), or 'none' (disable prorations). Default: 'create_prorations'.
proration_behavior.title: Proration Behavior

proration_date.description: Calculates prorations as if resumed at specified time; useful for matching preview calculations. Unix timestamp in seconds.
proration_date.title: Proration Date

subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to resume.
subscription_id.title: Subscription Id
